head.t: Daily Viagra-like pill shows promise in early Alzheimer’s disease
head.x: A Viagra-like daily pill that increases blood flow to the brain has shown promising results in slowing the progression of Alzheimer’s disease in phase 3 trials.

head.t: Sirtex Medical acquires US FDA-approved Hourglass vascular plug
head.x: Sirtex Medical has today announced it has acquired the Hourglass embolization plug—a US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k)-cleared vascular plug indicated to obstruct or reduce the rate of blood flow in the peripheral vasculature in vessels 6–8mm in diameter.

f.t: Fisher and Paykel locked in as sole supplier for respiratory consumables at St George's
f.x: St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has made a direct, sole-source award to Fisher and Paykel Healthcare worth £750,000 for invasive, non-invasive and nasal high-flow consumables, citing their compatibility with equipment the trust already has in place.

f.t: 14 urgent care schemes to receive share of £140m to help tackle winter pressures
f.x: £140 million in funding will be invested in 14 new urgent care schemes across England to help tackle winter pressures, the government has announced, aiming to increase capacity and improve patient flow. These schemes include ED improvements, new urgent treatment centres, and enhancements to digital systems.
